highlights: When you create a new variety, you can now record its Genus and Species — the botanical name that settles what a plant actually is.
Plants that should never be fed on a schedule can now say so. Rosemary, sage, oregano, both tarragons, goldenrod, yarrow and horseweed have stopped asking to be fertilised every two weeks.
Internal: a standing check catches care research left stranded when a rename mints a new variety row, plus a guard that fails loudly if the audit trigger it relies on is ever removed.
